meta.title: 12 historical industry research portfolios
meta.sourceHeader:
This file was created using the 202607 CRSP database.
It contains value- and equal-weighted returns for 12 industry portfolios.

The portfolios are constructed at the end of June.

The annual returns are from January to December.

Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.
meta.warmupNote: 1994–1999 retained for formation history; default evaluation is 2000–2025.
meta.limitations: Reconstructed value-weighted industry portfolios, not stock/ETF prices or modern fixed sectors. No live or intraday data. Historical data can be revised.
